description: Find subdomains from Certificate Transparency logs and a common-name wordlist, and detect subdomain takeovers: CNAMEs to S3, GitHub Pages, Azure, Heroku, Netlify and other providers whose resource is gone (verified fingerprints), or to targets that no longer exist

certificateTransparency.description: Add names found in Certificate Transparency logs via crt.sh and Cert Spotter (default: true; sends only the domain name)

domain.description: Root domain to enumerate subdomains for (e.g. example.com)

httpProbe.description: Fetch pages behind provider CNAMEs to match takeover fingerprints (default: true)

name: enumerate_subdomains
